_sight: Eyes, but only the cheap ones. Nothing here is ever looked at in high detail: a question about a label is answered from the local OCR and the low-detail glance rather than by paying sixteen times for the picture again, and a reading is given at the same detail rather than refused. Pro is where the close look is affordable.

Toolkit.//Enabled: Off on Free/Budget -- a toolkit that can run arbitrary PowerShell is not something a cost-free tier reaches silently off a semantic match.

_thinking: Free's local archive work; Intent goes to the API. Reflection does not run here either -- see UseSubstrate false below.

Agents.//Sight: Eyes. Low detail every turn, escalating to high only when the turn asks for a close reading -- see the Sight section in appsettings.json. Effort none: describing a picture is not a reasoning task, and a thinking budget here is latency the turn cannot spend.
